title: Garments, Vision, Prayer, and the Final Substances
summary: The closing sequence of eleven teachings: the Five Garments of the First Man and the Pentecost of the soul; the hidden things in the eye and senses with their two opposing hosts; the five-fold cosmos that cannot stand if any one is missing; the ascent of light through the gates and firmaments of the four climes; the three icons in the righteous man (pneumatic, psychic, somatic) and the daily soul-cycle; the threefold prayer of the Mother and the threefold sending of Living Spirit, Ambassador, and Radiance; why pruning the extremities does not pain because the Living Soul is in the members proper; the soul loosed in sickness as a typology of mystical seeing; the foundational restatement of the Two Substances and the work of separation; and the final cosmic scaffolding revealed as the Yes (Calling) and the Amen (Hearing).
organizing_principle: Consummating teachings that gather the architecture of the regenerate human (three icons), the pattern of prayer-and-sending, mystical experience, and the foundational dualism — closing with the identification of all cosmic scaffolding as the Calling and the Hearing.
